items.title: Nubank rejects Monzo takeover talk
items.excerpt: Brazilian digital banking giant Nubank has denied that it is pursuing a $10 billion takeover of Britain's Monzo.

items.title: Revolut gets green light to buy Argentinian bank
items.excerpt: Revolut has received the regulatory go-ahead to acquire small Argentinian lender Banco Cetelem from BNP Paribas.

items.title: Nubank launches deposit account in the US
items.excerpt: Brazilian digital giant Nubank has launched in the US, rolling out a suite of products through a partnership with a sponsor bank.

items.title: Nubank appoints Circle's  Sarah Wilson chief legal officer
items.excerpt: Nubank, the largest digital bank in Latin America, today announced the appointment of Sarah Wilson as Chief Legal Officer (CLO), effective September 28th.

items.title: N26 expands Flexible Cash Fund access to all membership tiers
items.excerpt: N26 today announced the expansion of its Flexible Cash Fund, making the investment product available across all N26 membership tiers.

items.title: Wise to pay clients' tax bills after third-party software error
items.excerpt: Money transfer app Wise has contacted the UK's tax authorities over technical errors that led thousands of clients to pay the wrong amount of tax on their investments.

items.title: Revolut eyes Philippines bank licence
items.excerpt: Digital bank Revolut is considering the Philippines as the next market in its global expansion plans
